title: Algerian Chicken Tagine
description: A traditional Algerian stew made with chicken, tomatoes, and spices, slow-cooked in a clay pot.

ingredients.name: tagine spice blend
ingredients.notes: or a combination of cumin, coriander, and paprika

instructions: Heat oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add tagine spice blend, tomato, lemon juice, and water.
Bring to a boil, then cover and transfer to the oven.
Bake at 300°F for 30 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in olives and simmer for an additional 10 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.
